title: Skeleton Rigging Joint Hierarchy Viewer with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an interactive skeleton rigging joint hierarchy viewer with full time control. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Dark background (0x1a1a2e). Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8), looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (0x404060, intensity 0.4) and a directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) from (5, 10, 5).
- Add a subtle grid helper (size 10, divisions 10, color 0x333355) on the ground plane.
- Use OrbitControls for camera manipulation.

## Skeleton Construction
- Build a humanoid skeleton hierarchy using Three.js Bone objects with the following joint tree:
  - Root (hip) at (0, 1.0, 0)
    - Spine at relative (0, 0.4, 0)
      - Chest at relative (0, 0.4, 0)
        - Head at relative (0, 0.35, 0)
        - LeftShoulder at relative (-0.3, 0.3, 0)
          - LeftElbow at relative (-0.35, 0, 0)
            - LeftHand at relative (-0.3, 0, 0)
        - RightShoulder at relative (0.3, 0.3, 0)
          - RightElbow at relative (0.35, 0, 0)
            - RightHand at relative (0.3, 0, 0)
    - LeftHip at relative (-0.2, 0, 0)
      - LeftKnee at relative (0, -0.45, 0)
        - LeftFoot at relative (0, -0.45, 0)
    - RightHip at relative (0.2, 0, 0)
      - RightKnee at relative (0, -0.45, 0)
        - RightFoot at relative (0, -0.45, 0)
- Render each bone as a small sphere (radius 0.06, 0x00ff88) and connections between parent-child bones as thin cylinders (radius 0.015, 0x00cc66).
- Add a SkeletonHelper for wireframe visualization.

## Animation System
- Define a procedural walk cycle animation with duration 2.0 seconds that loops.
- The walk cycle should animate: hip vertical bob (sine wave, amplitude 0.05), left/right leg alternating swing (LeftHip/RightHip X-rotation oscillating between -0.4 and 0.4 radians, opposite phase), knee bend (LeftKnee/RightKnee X-rotation 0 to 0.6 radians), arm swing opposite to legs (LeftShoulder/RightShoulder X-rotation between -0.3 and 0.3), and subtle head sway (Head Z-rotation, amplitude 0.05).
- All rotations use sine/cosine interpolation based on normalized time (0 to 1).

## Time Control
- Maintain a timeline with: currentTime (0 to 2.0), playbackSpeed (default 1.0), isPlaying (default true).
- Pressing SPACE toggles play/pause.
- Pressing LEFT arrow steps backward by 0.05s (clamp to 0). Pressing RIGHT arrow steps forward by 0.05s (clamp to 2.0). These only work when paused.
- Pressing 1 sets playbackSpeed to 0.25 (slow-mo). Pressing 2 sets playbackSpeed to 1.0 (normal). Pressing 3 sets playbackSpeed to 2.0 (fast).

## Joint Selection
- Clicking on a joint sphere highlights it: change its color to 0xff4444 and scale to 1.8x. Previously selected joint reverts to default (0x00ff88, scale 1.0).
- Use raycasting on the joint spheres for click detection.
- When a joint is selected, display its info in a HUD panel.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left panel showing: 'Time: X.XXs / 2.00s', 'Speed: Xs', 'Status: Playing/Paused', 'Joints: 15', 'Selected: [jointName or None]'.
- Bottom of screen: a timeline scrubber bar (HTML div, width 80%, height 20px, background 0x333355). A progress indicator (inner div, green 0x00ff88) fills proportionally to currentTime/2.0. Clicking on the scrubber bar sets currentTime to the proportional position.
- Top-right: display the joint hierarchy as an indented text list. The selected joint name should be highlighted in red (#ff4444) in this list.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
  - currentTime: number (0 to 2.0)
  - playbackSpeed: number
  - isPlaying: boolean
  - totalJoints: number (should be 15)
  - selectedJoint: string or null (bone name)
  - jointPositions: object mapping joint names to {x, y, z} world positions
  - jointRotations: object mapping joint names to {x, y, z} local Euler rotations in radians
  - hierarchyDepth: number (max depth of the bone tree, should be 5: Root->LeftHip->LeftKnee->LeftFoot = depth 4 from root, but Root->Spine->Chest->LeftShoulder->LeftElbow->LeftHand = depth 5)
  - animationProgress: number (currentTime / 2.0, range 0 to 1)
  - frameCount: number (increments each render frame)
  - boneConnections: number (total parent-child connections, should be 14)
- Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Joint rotations must stay within defined limits (e.g., knee bend 0 to 0.6 rad, hip swing -0.4 to 0.4 rad). All world positions must be NaN-free. Hierarchy depth must remain consistent. Timeline must clamp between 0 and 2.0. Animation progress must equal currentTime / 2.0 at all times.
